notes.note: We got the old Wilkie back this week with 12 marks and 21 disposals.  He had a big first quarter with 49 points but scored just 35 in the second half.

Wilkie just can't get some consistency and this was his second lowest of the season with just 10 disposals and 4 tackles.  He wasn't taking the kick ins. He hasn't had a kick in now for three weeks. Stocker took them once Nas was missing.
This was much better from Wilkie. 13 marks for him with his 26 disposals at 92% as he played 100% game time. This style of game from him is what we were seeing when he went on his great scoring run.

Again Wilkie has been held below 100. This was better than last week but not by much with 9 marks and just 15 disposals. He has had to be more responsible with no Sinclair and he can't just free wheel like he was.
Wilkie had the job on first gamer Polkinghorne and didn't have a good night. Just 15 touches at 86% as he wasn't able to get his offensive game going. He is going to get more attention going forward.

We knew Wilkie was going to take full advantage of Sinclair missing and that he did with 16 marks and a 97% efficiency for his 34 disposals and a huge score was the result! If you need a defender he is a great option.
Wilkie had the back role with Sinclair missing now for the rest of the year. He ended the game with 11 marks and his 21 disposals came at 85%. This should be a base for him hopefully.
With Sinclair out injured we saw Wilkie's numbers increase as he took 14 marks and 26 disposals. If Sinclair misses a number of weeks we should see the best version of Wilkie.
Wilkie has been up and down lately but this was his lowest score in the last five games with his 21 disposals coming at just 61%.
Wilkie had a tough job on the tall Swan forwards and had just the 24 touches this week for his lowest in the last four weeks. He isn't quite getting the consistency we would like.

Wilkie got off to a quiet start with his role on Gunston but had a big second quarter ending with 23 disposals 7 marks and 9 contested possessions. His second over 100 in the last three which is a good comeback following his back injury.
Wilkie still looks to be suffering with his back injury but he played out the game with 21 disposals at 90%. He had the job minding Voss which meant he was a lockdown for much of the game.
Wilkie was able to play despite his sore back from last week and he put up a great score as he took 12 marks and his 25 disposals came at 92%.
Wilkie copped a knee to the back in the first term. He came back on but was taken out of the game at half time with just 5 disposals. Watch injury reports to see if he is good to go next week.
Whilst Wilkie's score was his first under 100 for the season he still took 12 marks and had 22 disposals. The ball wasn't in his area a great deal in the second half which didn't help his score.
Wilkie took a while to get going but he did and took 16 marks as he couldn't avoid the footy at times. 25 disposals at 96% efficiency led to yet another 100+ score.
Wilkie continues to be a star for the Saints with another 12 marks and 31 disposals this week. He hasn't been under 100 yet this season.
Wilkie hasn't dropped below 100 for the season so far and he needs to be someone that we consider going forward. He has a good role and these points should continue to flow.
Wilkie has had a great start to the season with his fourth score over 100 in his first four games. He is one that you have to seriously consider as he has a great role.
Wilkie was fantastic and has a great role down back as he had 11 marks and 28 disposals. Don't discount him in your plans for the season.
Wilkie has been a solid performer over the last few seasons and started well with a big possession game in opening round.
